root_cause: The merchant is paying a 2.0% blended MDR rate, which is 0.25 percentage points higher than the 1.75% true underlying network cost, resulting in a structural margin leak.
diagnosis: The comparison uses a modeled benchmark (illustrative source status) showing that the current flat-rate pricing structure does not reflect the actual interchange and network costs, causing the merchant to overpay by Rs 11,109.29 on a volume of Rs 4,406,770.11.
action_rationale: Switching to an Interchange-Plus pricing model will align fees with actual network costs, eliminating the structural spread and capturing the savings from the 0.25% rate differential.
